messages.subject: [amelia] Amelia 1.5
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

We are happy to announce that Amelia 1.5 is up on our website. This
version includes a major redesign of the AmeliaView GUI and we are
eager to get your feedback. You can install the new version using the
following command in R:

install.packages("Amelia", repos="http://r.iq.harvard.edu", type = "source")

If you would like to install the Windows version (standalone GUI, no
contact with R) you can download the installer here:

http://gking.harvard.edu/amelia/amelia-setup.exe

Finally, the documentation has been updated with information about the
new interface:

http://gking.harvard.edu/amelia/docs/amelia.pdf

Please let us know if you have any questions or issues with Amelia. We
are looking forward to your feedback to make Amelia better.

Cheers,
matt.

~~~~~~~~~~~
Matthew Blackwell
PhD Candidate
Institute for Quantitative Social Science
Department of Government
Harvard University
url: http://people.fas.harvard.edu/~blackwel/
